sourceText:
Easy Ginger-Orange Marmalade
By: Thecoffeebreak
Published: Monday, April 12, 2010 - 1:33pm

Ingredients




3 large oranges
4 tablespoons ginger powder
450 grams sugar
100 ml water

Preparation

1 Wash the oranges thoroughly then grate orange rind, set aside. 2 Peel the white pith from the oranges and remove seeds. 3 Chop oranges into rough pieces and transfer to a blender or food processor. Blend until finely ground. 4 In a medium saucepan place all ingredients and bring it to a boil then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. 5 When done let it cool for a bit before transferring to a sterilised jars.

About


Orange marmalade is one of the favourites in our house. It’s always nice to have home-made marmalade in a kitchen cupboard so if you fancy something – just open cupboard door and it’s there :-)
Made from fresh oranges and ginger adds a little kick – wonderful spread on toast or biscuits.
